title: VIASM-IAMP Summer School 2027 on Probability and Mathematical Physics
institution: Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM)
about: VIASM-IAMP Summer School on Probability and Mathematical Physics at VIASM, Hanoi, 23-28 July 2027, a satellite event of ICMP 2027 in Da Nang. Four mini-courses and ten contributed talks by young participants. In-person registration via online form by 1 July 2027.

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: field "Probability and mathematical physics" → objective "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
